purpose: Input-only native token costs for the fixed Qwen2.5-7B Kaggle target; no model weights or target outputs are included.
provenance: Bytes copied from the existing Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct tokenizer cache after independently verifying every file SHA256 is identical to the 7B Kaggle version-1 tokenizer used by completed v5 target preflight. No assumption of tokenizer equivalence substitutes for these byte checks.
